heading_en: Credit Risk-Weighted Assets for the Default Fund of a Qualifying Central Counterparty
summary_ja: 適格中央清算機関に係る清算基金の信用リスク・アセットは、所要自己資本額K_{CMi}に12.5を乗じて算出する。算式、EAD_{i}の算出方法、分別管理の場合の扱い、及び適格中央清算機関以外の中央清算機関と仮定した場合との比較上限を定める。
summary_en: Credit RWA for the default fund of a qualifying central counterparty is the required capital K_{CMi} times 12.5; the article gives the formula, how EAD_{i} is computed, treatment of segregated funds and accounts, and a cap by comparison with treating the central counterparty as non-qualifying.
paragraphs: The amount of credit risk-weighted assets for the default fund relating to a qualifying central counterparty shall be calculated by multiplying the required capital amount (K_{CMi}) calculated by the following formula by 12.5. (i) The required capital amount (K_{CMi}) shall be calculated using the following formula. {{F:p307i0}} {{F:p307i1}} {{F:p307i2}} is the amount of the default fund contributed to that qualifying central counterparty by direct clearing participant i. DF_{CCP} is the amount of the capital and other similar resources held by that qualifying central counterparty that bear the losses arising to that qualifying central counterparty from the default of a direct clearing participant simultaneously with, or ahead of, the default fund (excluding the default fund of the defaulting participant). {{F:p307i3}} is the total amount of the default fund contributed to that qualifying central counterparty by direct clearing participants. EAD_{i} is the amount of the trade exposure that that qualifying central counterparty has to direct clearing participant i. (ii) EAD_{i} in the preceding item shall be the amount specified in (a) or (b) below according to the category of transaction listed there. (a) Derivative transactions: the amount calculated using SA-CCR; provided, however, that the amount of the default fund contributed by the direct clearing participant shall be included in the amount of collateral received, and the margin period of risk shall be 10 business days. (b) Repo-style transactions: the amount calculated by the following formula. EAD_{i} = max(EBRM_{i} − IM_{i} − DFi, 0) EBRM_{i} is the amount obtained by adding the amount of the initial margin contributed by that direct clearing participant to the amount of the exposure that that qualifying central counterparty has to direct clearing participant i (being the amount after the application of the credit risk mitigation techniques of Article 80). IM_{i} is the amount of the initial margin contributed by direct clearing participant i. DF_{i} is the amount of the default fund contributed by direct clearing participant i. (iii) Where the required capital amount (K_{CMi}) is calculated under (b) of the preceding item, notwithstanding Article 76, paragraph (2), item (i)(d), it is not necessary to set the minimum holding period at 20 business days for netting sets for which the number of transactions exceeded 5,000 at any point during the Ultimate Designated Parent Company quarter immediately preceding the Ultimate Designated Parent Company quarter that includes the calculation reference date. (iv) Where the initial margin relating to the trade exposures in the formula provided in item (i) covers both derivative transactions and repo-style transactions, the amounts of the initial margin relating to those derivative transactions and the initial margin relating to those repo-style transactions shall be amounts allocated in proportion between the amount specified in (a) of item (ii) (being the amount on the assumption that no collateral is exchanged) and the amount specified in (b) of that item. (v) Where that qualifying central counterparty segregates its default fund by specified category, the required capital amount in item (i) shall be calculated for each such category. In this case, where DF_{CCP} is not segregated by those categories, DF_{CCP} for each category shall be the amount allocated in proportion to the amount of Σ_{i}EAD_{i}. (vi) Notwithstanding item (ii), where a direct clearing participant segregates its own account from the accounts for each indirect clearing participant (where the accounts of multiple indirect clearing participants are managed collectively, meaning each of the accounts managed collectively; the same applies hereinafter in this item and the following item), the sum of the amount of the trade exposures of its own account and the amount of the trade exposures of the account for each indirect clearing participant shall be EAD_{i}. (vii) In the case of the preceding item, where the default fund contributed by the direct clearing participant is not divided between the direct clearing participant's own account and the accounts for each indirect clearing participant, that default fund shall be allocated in proportion to the amount of the initial margin relating to its own account and the amount of the initial margin relating to the accounts for each indirect clearing participant.

Notwithstanding the preceding Article and the preceding paragraph, the sum of the amounts listed in the following items (hereinafter in this paragraph simply referred to as the "total amount") shall be compared with the sum of the amounts listed in the following items on the assumption that the qualifying central counterparty were a central counterparty other than a qualifying central counterparty (hereinafter in this paragraph referred to as the "hypothetical total amount"), and where the total amount exceeds the hypothetical total amount, the hypothetical total amount shall be the sum of the amounts of credit risk-weighted assets for trade exposures to that qualifying central counterparty and for the default fund relating to that qualifying central counterparty. (i) The amount of credit risk-weighted assets for trade exposures to that qualifying central counterparty. (ii) The amount of credit risk-weighted assets for the default fund relating to that qualifying central counterparty.
